name: Fractions and decimals
description:
Fraction: a number a/b, meaning a parts when one whole is divided into b equal parts.
Decimal: the same kind of number written with a decimal point, where each place to the right is a tenth of the one before.

name: Variable and formula
description:
Variable: a letter that stands for a quantity which can take different values.
Formula: a rule, written with variables, that shows how one quantity is calculated from others.

name: Calculate with a formula
description: put given values into a formula from daily life or work, calculate the result, and give it with the right unit

name: Convert between units
description: convert between units of length, area, volume, mass and time, including square and cubic units

name: Power and square root
description:
Power: a product of equal factors, written a^n, where the base a is multiplied by itself n times and n is the exponent.
Square root: the non-negative number that gives a when it is multiplied by itself.

name: Equation
description:
Equation: a statement that two expressions are equal.
Solution: the value of the variable that makes the statement true.

name: Solve a linear equation
description: solve an equation of the first degree by doing the same to both sides, and check the answer by putting it back in

name: Rearrange a formula
description: rearrange a simple formula to find a quantity other than the one it is written for

name: System of equations
description:
System of equations: two equations with two unknowns that must both hold at the same time.
Solution of a system: the pair of values that makes both equations true.

name: Solve a system of two linear equations
description: solve a system of two linear equations by substitution or by elimination, and check the solution in both equations

name: Inequality
description:
Inequality: a statement that one expression is greater than, or less than, another.
Solution set: all the values of the variable that make the inequality true.

name: Solve a linear inequality
description: solve a linear inequality, turning the sign when both sides are multiplied or divided by a negative number, and state the solution set

name: Set up and solve an equation, system or inequality from a situation
description: turn a practical situation into an equation, a system of equations or an inequality, solve it, and argue for why each step and the chosen strategy are valid

name: Percentage
description: Percentage: a number of hundredths, so 40 % means 40 out of 100.

name: Calculate a percentage of an amount
description: find a given percentage of an amount, and find what percentage one amount is of another

name: Percentage point
description: Percentage point: the unit for the difference between two percentages, so a rise from 20 % to 25 % is 5 percentage points but a 25 % increase.

name: Explain the difference between percent and percentage points
description: explain whether a change between two percentages is described in percent or in percentage points, and calculate both

name: Growth factor
description: Growth factor: the number an amount is multiplied by in one percentage change, 1 + p/100 for an increase of p % and 1 − p/100 for a decrease of p %.

name: Calculate the growth factor from a percentage
description: find the growth factor from a percentage increase or decrease, and the percentage change from a growth factor

name: Calculate a new value with a growth factor
description: calculate the value after a percentage change by multiplying by the growth factor

name: Find the value before a percentage change
description: find the original value when the new value and the percentage change are known, by dividing by the growth factor

name: Calculate the value after repeated percentage changes
description: calculate the value after several percentage changes in a row, using a power of the growth factor when the changes are equal

name: Linear and exponential growth
description:
Linear growth: an amount that changes by the same number each period.
Exponential growth: an amount that changes by the same percentage each period, so it is multiplied by the same growth factor each time.

name: Set up a model of a practical situation
description: decide whether a situation shows linear or exponential growth, write an expression for the amount after n periods, and use it to find values

name: Find when a growing amount reaches a value
description: find, by trying values with a calculator, after how many periods an amount under a percentage change reaches a given value

name: Model a percentage change with a digital tool
description: use a spreadsheet or a short program to calculate an amount period by period under a percentage change, and find when it passes a given value
instruction: This node is practised on a computer and is not examined in either part of the exam, so a spreadsheet or a program is welcome here.

name: Index and consumer price index
description:
Index: a number that shows how a price or quantity has changed relative to a base year, where the base year is set to 100.
Consumer price index: an index for the prices of the goods and services a typical household buys.

name: Calculate with index numbers
description: use index numbers to find what a price in one year corresponds to in another year

name: Nominal wage, real wage and krone value
description:
Nominal wage: the wage in the kroner actually paid.
Real wage: the wage measured in base-year kroner, the nominal wage divided by the consumer price index and multiplied by 100.
Krone value: what one krone buys compared with the base year, 100 divided by the consumer price index.

name: Calculate krone value and real wage
description: calculate krone value and real wage from the consumer price index

name: Gross and net income
description:
Gross income: income before tax and other deductions.
Net income: what is left of the income after tax and other deductions.
Withholding tax: the tax the employer deducts from each pay, given as a percentage or from a tax table.

name: Calculate net income from gross income
description: calculate net income from gross income and a given withholding percentage or tax table amount

name: Explain what decides how much a wage buys
description: explain how price changes, nominal wage and tax together decide how much a wage can buy, and calculate whether purchasing power has risen or fallen

name: Interest and interest rate
description:
Interest: money paid for borrowing money, or earned on money saved.
Interest rate: the interest for one period as a percentage of the amount.

name: Calculate savings with compound interest
description: calculate the balance on a savings account after several years when the interest is added to the balance each year

name: Serial loan and annuity loan
description:
Instalment: the part of a payment that pays down the debt.
Term amount: what is paid each term, the instalment plus the interest.
Serial loan: a loan with the same instalment every term, so the term amount falls over time.
Annuity loan: a loan with the same term amount every term, so the instalment grows over time.

name: Set up a repayment plan for a serial loan
description: set up a repayment plan for a serial loan term by term, showing remaining debt, interest, instalment and term amount

name: Compare a serial loan and an annuity loan
description: compare the term amounts and the total interest of a serial loan and an annuity loan for the same amount, and say which suits a given borrower

name: Credit card and effective interest rate
description:
Credit card: a card that lets the holder buy now with borrowed money and pay later, with high interest on any amount not paid by the due date.
Effective interest rate: the total yearly cost of a loan, fees included, as a percentage of the amount borrowed.

name: Calculate the cost of credit card debt
description: calculate how a credit card debt grows when only part of it is paid each month, and what the purchase ends up costing

name: Set up a budget and compare it with accounts
description: set up a monthly budget of income and expenses, compare it with what was actually spent, and suggest changes where it does not balance

name: Judge a choice in personal finance
description: weigh the costs and risks of taking up a loan or buying on credit against saving first, and argue for a choice and its consequences

name: Categorical and numerical data
description:
Categorical data: observations that are categories, such as favourite sport.
Numerical data: observations that are numbers, such as height in centimetres.

name: Population and sample
description:
Population: the whole group a statistical investigation is about.
Sample: the part of the population that is actually asked or measured.
Representative sample: a sample that resembles the population in the ways that matter for the question.

name: Frequency
description:
Frequency: how many times an observation occurs.
Relative frequency: the frequency divided by the total number of observations, often written as a percentage.
Cumulative frequency: the sum of the frequencies up to and including an observation.

name: Set up a frequency table
description: set up a frequency table with relative and cumulative frequency from raw data

name: Choose and draw a suitable diagram
description: choose a bar chart, pie chart or line chart to fit the data and the question, and draw it with labelled axes

name: Measures of centre
description:
Mean: the sum of the observations divided by the number of observations.
Median: the middle observation when all are sorted by size, or the mean of the two middle ones.
Mode: the observation that occurs most often.

name: Calculate mean, median and mode
description: calculate mean, median and mode from raw data and from a frequency table

name: Measures of spread
description:
Range: the largest observation minus the smallest.
Quartiles: the values that divide the sorted observations into four equal parts.
Interquartile range: the upper quartile minus the lower quartile.
Standard deviation: a measure of how far the observations typically lie from the mean.

name: Calculate range and interquartile range
description: calculate the range, the quartiles and the interquartile range of a data set

name: Calculate the standard deviation
description: calculate the standard deviation of a small data set with a scientific calculator

name: Choose suitable measures of centre and spread
description: choose the measure of centre and of spread that best describes a data set, such as the median when there are extreme values, and justify the choice

name: Grouped data
description:
Class interval: one of the ranges grouped data is divided into, such as 10–20 minutes.
Class midpoint: the value halfway between the ends of a class interval.
Class width: the length of a class interval.

name: Estimate the mean of grouped data
description: estimate the mean of grouped data using class midpoints, and find the class that contains the median

name: Draw and read a histogram
description: draw a histogram where the area of each bar shows the frequency, and read frequencies from one

name: Compare two data sets
description: compare two data sets using a measure of centre and a measure of spread, and draw a conclusion that answers the question

name: Judge how statistics are presented
description: point out where a diagram, percentage or average in the media gives a misleading picture, and say what a fairer presentation would show

name: Analyse and present findings from a data set
description: analyse a data set from the local community or the media, present the findings in tables and diagrams, and draw conclusions that state their limits

name: Properties of plane figures
description:
Right-angled triangle: a triangle with one angle of 90°, where the longest side, opposite the right angle, is the hypotenuse.
Angle sum: the total of the angles in a figure, 180° in a triangle and 360° in a quadrilateral.
Parallelogram: a quadrilateral where both pairs of opposite sides are parallel.
Trapezium: a quadrilateral with exactly one pair of parallel sides.
Circle: all the points at the same distance, the radius, from a centre.

name: Calculate unknown angles
description: calculate unknown angles in triangles and quadrilaterals from the angle sum and the properties of the figure

name: Perimeter and area
description:
Perimeter: the total length of the edge of a plane figure.
Area: the size of the surface a plane figure covers, measured in square units.

name: Calculate perimeter and area
description: calculate the perimeter and area of triangles, rectangles, parallelograms, trapezia, circles and figures made of these, with the right units

name: Volume
description: Volume: the space a solid takes up, measured in cubic units.

name: Calculate the volume of prisms and cylinders
description: calculate the volume of prisms and cylinders as base area times height, with the right units

name: Pythagoras' theorem
description: Pythagoras' theorem: in a right-angled triangle, the square of the hypotenuse equals the sum of the squares of the two other sides.

name: Use Pythagoras' theorem to find a side
description: find an unknown side in a right-angled triangle with Pythagoras' theorem, and check whether a triangle is right-angled

name: Similar figures
description:
Similar figures: figures with the same shape, where corresponding angles are equal and corresponding sides have the same ratio.
Scale factor: the ratio between corresponding sides in two similar figures.

name: Calculate unknown sides in similar figures
description: show that two figures are similar, and find unknown sides by setting up and solving an equation from equal ratios

name: Scale
description: Scale: the ratio between a length on a map or drawing and the real length, written such as 1 : 50 000.

name: Calculate with scale
description: find a real length from a drawing or map, a drawn length from a real one, and the scale from the two

name: Use geometry in a practical task
description: plan and calculate a practical task, such as the material for a floor or a scale drawing of a room, by choosing the right figures, formulas and units
